rationale: This is a pure normalization tweak of the archived Cash_Value_Times_Operating_Discipline_Composite (and a two-leg subset of Cash_Value_Times_Three_Channel_Discipline, which already z-scores both of these legs), so it adds no new economic content and merely reshuffles leg weights in a family already showing signs of weight-tuning overfit.

The three channels (bounded financing ratio, bounded deployment mix, own-history inventory) are exactly those of the archived Cash_Value_Times_Three_Channel_Discipline, differing only in whether two legs are z-scored, making this a cosmetic re-weighting rather than a substantively different hypothesis.

Replacing the uniform-by-construction TS_RANK with a bounded, magnitude-preserving deviation-from-own-mean is a defensible measurement change (not just a rescaling) that cleanly separates "inventory concept" from "leg dispersion," though it remains an incremental refinement within a saturated family and the two legs' effective weights are still asserted rather than verified.

By the proposal's own logic the raw aqc-sum/assets penalty is an order of magnitude smaller than the z-scored mix, so the signal collapses toward the already-archived Cash_Value_Times_Organic_Versus_Acquisitive_Outlay — a near-rediscovery whose "repair" is again just relative scaling.

Own-history capacity utilization is a genuinely new operating channel in this archive (distinct from the failed one-year sales/ppegt growth leg paired with a replacement-cost value leg), the sign logic is internally consistent, and the coverage argument versus inventory is economically motivated rather than cosmetic.

A coherent coverage-robust three-channel construction whose value lies mainly in being the controlled contrast to the inventory version, but it is largely redundant with Proposal 5 in this same batch and inherits the unverified raw-versus-z-scored weighting assumption of the gen-7 parent.
